name: homebridge-delonghi-coffee
description: Apple Home for De'Longhi Bluetooth coffee machines (PrimaDonna, Dinamica, Eletta, Maestosa...) via an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy or the server's Bluetooth

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:mqtt --external:@stoprocent/noble --external:@2colors/esphome-native-api --external:homebridge --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"

author: bubez81
